fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects suspicious ways to run Invoke-Execution using IEX alias
fields.name: Suspicious PowerShell IEX Execution Patterns
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\powershell.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\pwsh.exe") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " | iex;" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " | iex " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " | iex}" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " | IEX ;" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " | IEX -Error" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " | IEX (new" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ");IEX ")) and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "::FromBase64String" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".GetString([System.Convert]::")) or (tgt.process.cmdline contains ")|iex;$" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ");iex($" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ");iex $" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " | IEX | " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " | iex\\\"")))
